measurement_scale.basis: source-backed expanded/resolution scale in log10 predicted-over-observed PCO2
measurement_scale.formula: sqrt(0.02^2 + (640 Pa / observed total pressure)^2) / ln(10)
measurement_scale.loading_treatment: state-input uncertainty reported separately; it is not hidden in the pressure residual weight

source.citation: Hilliard (2008), A Predictive Thermodynamic Model for an Aqueous Blend of Potassium Carbonate, Piperazine, and Monoethanolamine for Carbon Dioxide Capture from Flue Gas
locators: Section 2.3.4, printed pages 27-28: 0-8 bar reactor pressure transducer, accuracy +/-0.08% full scale
Section 2.3.4, printed page 28: vapor concentration relative expanded uncertainty +/-2.0%
Section 2.3.4, printed page 28: loading relative standard uncertainty +/-2.0%

measurement_scale.statistical_claim: not a covariance matrix or one-standard-deviation model

independent_coordinate_evidence.citation: Cai et al. (1996), Binary Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibria of Ethanolamines + Water, DOI 10.1021/je960118o
locators: Experimental Apparatus and Results: pressure controlled within +/-133 Pa; calibrated thermometer graduated in 0.1 K; maximum composition error 0.001 mole fraction
